general.descSound: Play a system beep sound when workflows complete, exports finish, or other important events occur.
general.descUpdates: Check for and download desktop app updates from the selected release channel.
general.descConfirmManyNodes: Running a workflow executes every node at once. Show a confirmation when a run would launch many model/provider nodes that could overload an API.
general.descManyNodesThreshold: Warn when a run would execute more than this many model/provider nodes (LLM, image, audio, API, etc.).
general.descAudioBuffer: Playback buffer for realtime audio (modular synth patches). Lower values reduce knob-to-ear latency; higher values prevent dropouts when the editor is busy.
general.descMaxParallelRuns: Maximum number of workflow runs you can execute at once. Additional runs queue and start automatically as running ones finish.
general.descMaxRunsPerWorkflow: How many runs of the same workflow may run at once before further runs queue. Applies to concurrent generation (timeline, sketch); canvas runs always stay sequential.
general.descSnapToGrid: Align nodes to the canvas grid while dragging. Also in the View menu of the desktop app.
general.descGridSize: Grid size used when Snap to Grid is on. The canvas grid is drawn every 25 units.
general.descAutosave: Automatically save your workflow at regular intervals.
general.descAutosaveInterval: How often to automatically save your workflow.
general.descCheckpoint: Create a checkpoint version before executing workflow.
general.descAutosaveOnClose: Automatically save when closing the tab or window.
